$doc: Sacrosanct 3.1 s10.6 / s21.2 — the checked-in dependency LOCK.
This file is the reproducibility control plane. It records every dependency the
Forge kernel build actually consumes: exact revision, archive hash, enabled
features, patches, toolchain constraint, target triplet and expected artifact
fingerprint. `deps.resolved.json` (generated, gitignored) records what a given
workstation actually realized; it never edits this file.
HASH HONESTY RULE — read before editing:
upstream.archive_sha256 is the sha256 of the UPSTREAM SOURCE ARCHIVE at
upstream.url. It is recorded ONLY when it was read from a real source. Where
the installed build predates the current homebrew-core formula, the archive
hash for the INSTALLED version is not obtainable offline, so it is null with
an explicit archive_sha256_reason. A null is never replaced by a guess, and
never by the bottle hash or by the hash of a DIFFERENT version's archive.
fingerprint.* are hashes of the INSTALLED TREE on this workstation, computed
by tools/deps/forge_deps.py. They are artifact fingerprints, not provenance.
Their construction is defined in that file's module docstring.

generator_fallback.name: Unix Makefiles
generator_fallback.reason: Sacrosanct s21.2 mandates Ninja. Ninja is NOT installed on this workstation (`which ninja` -> not found), so the -make preset variants exist as an explicitly non-conforming workstation fallback. tools/deps/forge_deps.py resolve reports ninja: null until it is seeded.

toolchain.apple_sdk: host default (not pinned yet — open gap)

modes.ONLINE_SEED: FORGE_NETWORK=ON. tools/deps/seed fetches exactly the missing pinned archives into .forge-local/sources/<name>/<revision>/ and verifies each against upstream.archive_sha256. An archive whose lock hash is null is REFUSED, not fetched.
modes.OFFLINE_BUILD: FORGE_NETWORK=OFF (the default). cmake/ForgeDeps.cmake blocks every configure-time fetch primitive and fails the configure if any CMake file in the project contains one.

dependencies.name: opencascade
dependencies.purpose: OCCT B-rep kernel — the A/B baseline the in-house forge::native kernel is measured against, and the STEP/BRep data-exchange path still in use. forge-kernel links a shrinking subset of its toolkits (OCCT-zero programme).

source.acquired_as: homebrew bottle (poured_from_bottle=true per the Cellar INSTALL_RECEIPT.json)

upstream.archive_sha256_provenance: homebrew-core formula `opencascade` 7.9.3 revision 0, read offline from the local Homebrew API cache via `brew info --json=v2 opencascade` -> .urls.stable.checksum. The INSTALLED version 7.9.3 EQUALS the formula version, so this hash is the archive of what is installed.

binary_provenance.note: The bottle hash identifies the PREBUILT tarball Homebrew poured, not the source archive. It is recorded separately from archive_sha256 on purpose.

linked_toolkits_conditional.TKBO, TKG2d: linked when the OCCT A/B baseline path is enabled

features.version_pin_enforced_by_cmake: EXPECTED_OCCT_VERSION=7.9 (major.minor) — the TKDE* data-exchange toolkit names differ across minor versions.

installed.note: LAST-RESORT fallback only. cmake/ForgeDeps.cmake warns loudly when this path is taken; before this track the hardcoded literal /opt/homebrew/opt/opencascade was the ONLY resolution path.

dependencies.name: boost
dependencies.purpose: Header-only Boost.Graph (connected_components) and Boost.Math constants, used ONLY by the vendored planegcs sketch solver. No Boost library is linked.

upstream.archive_sha256_reason: The INSTALLED version is 1.90.0 (Cellar 1.90.0_1) but the current homebrew-core formula has already moved to 1.92.0, so the offline formula cache carries the 1.92.0 archive hash, NOT 1.90.0's. Recording that hash here would be a fabrication. Resolve by seeding the mirror while online (tools/deps/seed) and recording the hash of the archive actually downloaded, or by pinning the formula revision.

binary_provenance.note: Same reason as archive_sha256: the cached formula's bottle hash is 1.92.0's.

license.note: MEASURED: no license file is present anywhere under the installed prefix (`find <prefix> -maxdepth 3 -iname '*LICENSE*'` returned nothing). tools/deps/forge_deps.py notices therefore reports this attribution record as INCOMPLETE rather than inventing the text.

installed.note: LAST-RESORT fallback only; before this track the literal /opt/homebrew/opt/boost/include was hardcoded in forge-kernel/CMakeLists.txt.

dependencies.name: planegcs
dependencies.purpose: FreeCAD's 2D plane geometric constraint solver, vendored in-tree so Forge ships a sketch solver without depending on the wider FreeCAD codebase.

upstream.archive_sha256_reason: Vendored as a source subtree, not as an archive. Identity is the pinned upstream commit plus the fingerprint of the vendored files below.

features.eigen: NONE — compiled against the in-house drop-in <Eigen/...> shim forge-kernel/3rdParty/planegcs_eigen_shim, backed by forge::native::linalg. No real Eigen package is a dependency.

license.note: SPDX-License-Identifier header is present in every vendored source file; provenance and the Forge-local edits are documented in forge-kernel/3rdParty/planegcs/UPSTREAM.md.

patches.reason: The upstream FreeCAD tree is not present in the local mirror, so a byte-exact reverse diff cannot be produced offline without fabricating the upstream side. Instead the edit is recorded as an executable CONTRACT: the content_checks below are enforced by `tools/deps/forge_deps.py verify` and fail if the vendored sources ever drift back toward, or away from, the recorded state.

dependencies.name: node-addon-api
dependencies.purpose: Header-only Node-API C++ wrapper for the forge_kernel N-API addon (src/binding.cpp). Not needed by the node-free forge_kernel_core / forge::native targets.

upstream.archive_sha256_reason: package-lock.json is gitignored in this repo, so the npm integrity hash (sha512) for the installed tarball is not recorded in Git and the tarball itself is not in the local mirror. Nothing offline states it, so it stays null. Fix: stop gitignoring package-lock.json, or seed the tarball into .forge-local/sources and record its hash.

installed.note: Also resolvable from $FORGE_NODE_MODULES for worktree builds that reuse the main checkout's node_modules.

dependencies.name: vulkan-headers
dependencies.enabled_when: FORGE_BUILD_DESKTOP_RENDERER=ON or FORGE_BUILD_DESKTOP_UI=ON (both OFF by default)
dependencies.purpose: Vulkan API headers for the headless MoltenVK offscreen renderer and Dear ImGui UI probes.

upstream.archive_sha256_reason: Installed 1.4.350.1; the cached homebrew-core formula is already at 1.4.357.0, so no hash for 1.4.350.1 is available offline.

license.note: not recorded — optional dependency, prefix not activated in this lock revision

dependencies.name: vulkan-loader
dependencies.purpose: libvulkan.dylib loader linked by the renderer/UI probes.

dependencies.name: glslang
dependencies.purpose: glslangValidator — compiles the probes' GLSL to SPIR-V at build time.

dependencies.name: molten-vk
dependencies.purpose: Vulkan-on-Metal ICD used at RUN time by the headless probes (VK_ICD_FILENAMES).

known_gaps: Five of eight dependencies carry archive_sha256=null with an explicit reason. That is the honest state today, not an oversight: the installed builds predate the current homebrew-core formulas, and package-lock.json is gitignored. Closing them needs one ONLINE_SEED run (tools/deps/seed) plus recording the hashes actually observed.
No dependency is served from .forge-local/prefixes yet, so every resolution today ends at the machine-global fallback and warns. The plane is wired; the mirror is not yet populated.
The Apple SDK / compiler is not pinned. The installed_tree_sha256 fingerprints therefore identify the bottle, not the full toolchain.
Ninja is not installed on this workstation, so the spec-conforming presets cannot be executed here; the -make variants exist as a labelled fallback.
